connectionPaletteHint: ↑ ↓ to browse · Enter to add · Esc to cancel
resourceHint: Updates every 2 seconds. CPU shows activity across all cores and applications on the server machine. RAM shows total physical memory minus available memory; reclaimable caches count as available.
loginDescription: Sign in with your individual instance account.
passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Share the initial password privately.
name: Name
projectsDescription: Choose a project to continue building your pipeline.
noProjectsDescription: Create a project from scratch or explore the example to get started.
projectStartingPoint: Choose how to start your project
emptyProjectDescription: Start with a blank canvas and build a pipeline with your own data.
exampleDescription: The Northstar pipeline with its sample data.
dragHint: Drag a node onto the canvas
downloadProjectHint: Download the saved project files from this branch.
saveBeforeDownload: Save your changes before downloading the project.
noResultHint: Run this node and its ancestors to materialize a preview.
snapshotHint: Materialized at execution time. Refresh source data with a manual run.
staleHint: This is the last successful result. Recompute to explore lineage.
lineageInterrupted: This exploration was interrupted by recalculation or an edit. Select a cell in a new valid result.
compileHint: Compiling does not run the pipeline.
sharedTemplateHint: Changes affect every instance of this local definition in the current branch.
sharedComponentHint: You are editing a shared component definition in this branch.
catalogHint: Shared by all projects. Settings and secrets stay outside project Git history.
secretHint: Stored outside Git. Leave the masked value to keep the existing secret.
localPreferences: Theme and language are saved in this browser and shared by accounts using it.
metadataOnly: Historical records contain metadata only. Restarting clears in-memory previews and lineage.
restoreRevision: Open revision in a new branch
mergeHint: Resolve any conflicts in the combined files. The graph and interfaces must validate before merging.
conflictHint: Both proposals are preserved. Choose a version or edit a combined result.
invalidHint: Invalid content is saved and versioned. Correct the files to enable execution.
fileHint: UI and file edits share the same source of truth. Every save is automatically committed, including invalid content.
documentationPlaceholder: Describe the meaning, source, rules and assumptions…
importHint: Copies definitions and nested dependencies. Future changes in the source project do not affect your copy.
noNodesHint: Add a source from the palette, then connect transformations.
emptyDocumentation: Add context that travels with your pipeline.
aboutText: Duckpad is a local SQL workspace powered by DuckDB, React Flow and Python. All computation is manual; your project files are automatically versioned.
exposedHint: JSON map of parameter names to type, default and internal targets. See the example components.
cancelRunHint: Cancellation waits for active SQL and cleanup. Completed external writes are not undone.
schemaHint: Connect and run the input nodes to see their columns.
advancedExpressionHint: The generated SQL expressions below remain editable. Save parameters when ready.
resizeHint: Drag or use arrow keys. Double-click to reset.
unexpectedError: Something went wrong. Reload the page to continue.
usersDescription: Manage individual accounts and instance access.
instanceRolesHint: Instance admins manage all accounts, connections and projects. Members only see their projects.
deactivateHint: This account will lose access immediately. Project memberships are retained:
projectAccessHint: Private by default. Only participants and instance admins can access this project.
project_reader_hint: View the flow, SQL, history and existing results. No editing or execution.
project_editor_hint: Edit content and run, cancel or export the pipeline. Cannot manage access or delete the project.
project_admin_hint: Manage participants, change roles and delete the project, in addition to editing and execution.
lastAdminHint: Each project must keep at least one active administrator.
authorizedConnectionsHint: Only instance admins can authorize connections. Saving clears cached results; stop active executions first.
deleteProjectHint: Permanently delete the project, its branches, uploads and execution history.
confirmRemoveAccess: Remove project access for this participant?
passwordChangeHint: At least 12 characters. All sessions will end; sign in again afterward.
readerNotice: Read-only access · You can inspect the flow, SQL, history and existing results.
readerNoResult: An editor or admin must run this pipeline before results are available.
noProcessingImpact: No processing or wiring changes. Layout and names do not imply changed output values.
staticImpactHint: Static dependencies only. Schemas and output values are unresolved. No sources were read and no pipeline was run.
reviewMergeHint: Review the proposed changes and field conflicts before applying. Both branch histories are preserved. Changed heads or pending edits require a new review.
gitReaderHint: Readers can inspect comparisons and history. An editor role is required for Git mutations.
remoteAdminHint: A project administrator must configure origin and the upstream branch mapping.
configureOriginHint: Configure origin before fetching or publishing.
mappingRequired: Choose an explicit upstream branch mapping in remote configuration.
fetchFirst: Fetch first to verify the remote state.
serverGitAuthentication: Network Git runs on the Duckpad server using its configured authentication. Use HTTPS without credentials or an SSH URL. Keep tokens and passwords out of URLs. Configuration is shared across project worktrees and is never committed.
fetchPullHint: Fetch updates remote knowledge only. Incoming review uses the displayed fetched head. Applying a pull never pushes; publishing is a separate action.
resolveBeforeApply: Choose a value for every unresolved field.
fixBeforeApply: Correct the reported definitions on the source or destination branch, then start a new review.
removeIntegratedBranch: Remove integrated branch and its worktree:
recovery_diverged: Both branches have new commits. Review and apply a pull, then review publication.
recovery_unrelated: These histories have no common ancestor. Choose a related remote branch; automatic replacement is unavailable.
recovery_unverified: Save a branch mapping and fetch to verify origin.
recovery_remote_deleted: The previously fetched branch was deleted. Review publication and explicitly choose recreation if intended.
ssoDescription: Connect an identity provider to this instance. Local password sign-in remains available for recovery.
ssoSecretSaved: A secret is stored. Leave blank to keep it. Enter a new secret when changing the issuer or client ID.
ssoSecretRequired: Enter the confidential client secret from your identity provider.
ssoCallbackHint: Register this exact redirect URI with your provider. HTTPS is required except on loopback.
ssoAllowSignup: Create member accounts on first SSO sign-in
ssoAccessHint: New accounts have no access to existing private projects. Restrict who can use this client at your provider, then manage project membership in Duckpad.
ssoSaved: SSO settings saved. Existing SSO sessions have been signed out.
ssoPasswordManaged: This account signs in through SSO. Manage its password at the identity provider.
ssoFailed: Single sign-on failed or expired. Try again, or use your local account and check the SSO configuration.
ssoLocalLogin: Or sign in with a local account
instanceSettingsDescription: Shared configuration for all projects and users. Only instance administrators can make changes.
userSettingsDescription: Manage your preferences and account security.
accountIdentityHint: Project changes are committed with the signed-in account's identity, for both local and SSO accounts. External file changes are attributed to Duckpad.
instanceEnvironmentsHint: Manage the environments available to all projects and connections.
routeNotFoundHint: This address does not match a page.
routeUnavailableHint: This page no longer exists or you do not have access to it.
leavePageHint: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page and discard them?
environmentIdentifierHint: Stable identifier used by connections and execution history. It cannot be changed after creation.
environmentConfirmationHint: Ask for confirmation before each pipeline or node run from the workspace.
environmentConnectionHint: Configure connection values for this environment in Connections before running.
deleteEnvironmentHint: This removes the environment and its connection values. Execution history is kept. Stop active runs before deleting.
confirmRunHint: This environment requires confirmation before every run. Start the following execution?
unsignedExtensionsHint: Native extensions run code on the server. Enable this only for binaries you trust; it disables extension signature checks for this instance.
extensionSettingsApplyHint: Stop active runs before changing this option. Saving a change clears current results; run your pipelines again. No server restart is needed.
extensionDownloadHint: Use any computer with Internet access, including Windows or macOS. The download targets the Duckpad server; you do not need DuckDB on the downloading computer.
extensionCustomHint: Get a compatible binary from its publisher. Enable unsigned extensions below before importing an unsigned build.
extensionImportHint: Choose a .duckdb_extension or .duckdb_extension.gz file (64 MiB maximum). Duckpad checks it locally without Internet access. Stop active runs first; importing replaces this extension and clears current results. No server restart is needed.
extensionImported: Extension imported. Configure its connection and run your pipeline to check it on this server.
instanceSearchHint: Find projects, open branches, and nodes by name or ID. Only projects you can access are searched.
searchMore: More matches available. Refine your search.
searchIncomplete: Some project files could not be searched.
searchTargetMissing: This node has moved or been deleted. Search again.
lineageContextHint: These values explain row selection or comparison. They are not necessarily inputs to the calculation.
lineageNoInputs: This step has no contributing input cells.
lineageLimitedHint: Tracing stops here because this calculation cannot be fully explained.
lineageAverageReason: Total of the {count} contributing values divided by their count.
lineageMinimumReason: Smallest value in the group. The inputs show all {count} matching cells.
lineageMaximumReason: Largest value in the group. The inputs show all {count} matching cells.
lineageDistinctCountReason: Counts {count} distinct values; repeated values count once.
lineageInputsReason: The connected inputs are used in this calculation.
exportNotRun: Run this export successfully to download its file.
exportRunning: Export execution is in progress. The file will be available when it finishes.
exportFailed: The latest execution did not complete successfully. Run the export again.
exportStale: Inputs or settings have changed. Run the export again to download current data.
exportMissing: The exported file is missing or unavailable. Run the export again.
exportUnsupported: This destination does not produce a downloadable file.
exportChanged: A newer export is available. Review the result and download again.
